messages:
maria (sec): quick question — can non-admins run ad-hoc audit exports from the console? need to support a customer triage.
alexc: short answer: no. only roles with `audit:export` (admin or audit_exporter) can run exports. we support UI CSV, API export, and S3 archival.
jordan-r: what fields do those exports include by default? we need a simple ‘who did what’ view for support.
alexc: default fields: actor, action, target, timestamp, req_id, ip, region, meta. PII (email) is redacted per rules unless customer has explicit opt-in.
maria (sec): how is redaction applied? are we removing usernames for hosted exports or replacing w/ hashes?
alexc: hosted: we apply `audit-redact.yml` pipeline which replaces emails/usernames with `REDACTED` and hashes user_id if requested. private deployments: raw by default; customers can enable redaction via config and KMS integration.
security-bot: POLICY NOTE: Exports containing PII require Security + Privacy approval. Use `/request-export-approval <ticket>` and attach justification.
sam-ops: retention/availability: raw event store kept 90 days hot, parquet archive 365 days. ad-hoc export pulls from hot store; archival exports can include older data if requested via S3 restore (may take hours).
maria (sec): can you paste a sample header/row (tsv) so I can show support?
alexc: sure, sample TSV: 
```
actor\taction\ttarget\ttimestamp\treq_id\tip\tregion\tmeta
user:alice\tupdate\tpolicy:123\t2026-03-26T15:23:10Z\treq_abc123\t1.2.3.4\tus-west-2\t{"changes":1}
```
jordan-r: for “who did what” saved query use: `action:(role.change OR perm.grant) AND actor_type:user` — we added `WhoDidWhat-90d` in console saved queries.
maria (sec): is there visibility for export access? we need SIEM correlation (who viewed or downloaded exports).
alexc: yes — `export.access` events are emitted. payload includes actor, export_id, method (ui/api), success, and `target_bucket` when S3 export used. they appear in the same audit stream.
sam-ops: quick ops note: temporary exception exists for SRE on-call to run exports (policy ex-2026-03) until 2026-04-01. all such runs are logged and require post-hoc justification in the ticket.
security-bot: REMINDER: Any export that leaves the VPC must be scanned for secrets and approved. See KB: /kb/export-policy and follow the checklist.
maria (sec): ok filing request under ticket INC-789, will ping @alexc for approval. also need clarity for customers on CSV vs TSV.
alexc: recommend TSV when there are embedded JSON fields (meta), CSV ok for BI tools. always include header and `req_id` for traceability.
jordan-r: one more — does the export pipeline preserve `request_id` mapping so we can stitch to traces?
alexc: yes, `req_id` is preserved. if you need additional trace fields we can add `trace_id` to the export schema (requires small config change).
maria (sec): great; I'll request approval and confirm retention with legal if they ask for >365d. thanks :thumbsup:
alexc: ack, will review the approval.
sam-ops: FYI if you need longer retention we require a data-retention RFC + manager + legal signoff.
maria (sec): closing this thread — will update ticket when approved.
